documents.title: Promenade guardrail substitution question
documents.text: May stainless-steel grade 304 replace the specified grade 316 for external guardrail G-22 at promenade P-7?

documents.title: Plantroom maintenance hatch clear width
documents.text: What minimum clear opening width is specified for maintenance hatch MH-42 in plantroom L-5?

documents.title: Approved engineer response to substitution SR-88
documents.text: Substitution SR-88 for external guardrail G-22 at promenade P-7 is rejected. Stainless-steel grade 304 is not permitted for this guardrail; retain the specified grade 316. This is the final design decision for SR-88.

documents.title: Approved plantroom hatch schedule
documents.text: Maintenance hatch MH-42 in plantroom L-5 requires a minimum clear opening width of 850 mm. The installed hatch has not yet been inspected, and installation acceptance is not recorded.
